integrity: Proof given analytically; numerical tests are supplementary rather than an exhaustive proof or an independent review. Historically broader claims may predate identified sources.
scientific_limitations: Single constant-forcing thermal compartment, fixed-duty shade interval and cumulative squared positive thermal load. No empirical calibration, variable weather, photosynthesis response or crop-yield inference. Universal asymptotic requires fixed duration, fraction and initial load below the full-sun equilibrium.
title: A sharp antecedent-heat threshold and universal early-shading offset for one agrivoltaic window
